note_on_cofold_count: The organizer suggests cofolding a shortlist of 50-100. The ORDER was followed: 1,000,000 AbLang2 candidates and 50,000 ESM2-3B-scored candidates were screened by sequence first, and nothing was cofolded before screening. The cofold count exceeds 100 because spare GPU capacity was spent on REPLICATE SEEDS of the same shortlist rather than on more candidates: measured single-seed ipSAE reliability was only ~0.5, so replicates were required before any ranking could be trusted. The submission is still presented as a ranked top-50 shortlist with 15 nominations.
